english.title: Owner / vehicle operator of small ship / railway vehicle / aircraft / hovercraft connected to goods liable to forfeiture
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were the

(A)_[owner]_
(B)_[vehicle operator]_

of a

(C)_[ ship not exceeding 100 tons register, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SHIP..)]_
(D)_[a railway vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RAILWAY VEHICLE..)]_
(E)_[an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT..)]_
(F)_[a hovercraft, namely **(..SPECIFY THE HOVERCRAFT..),]_

which became liable to forfeiture under section 141 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 by reason of having been used in the

(G)_[importation]_
(H)_[exportation]_
(I)_[carriage]_

of goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..),

(J)_[contrary to a prohibition with respect to those goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PROHIBITION..)]_
(K)_[for the purpose of contravening a prohibition with respect to those goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PROHIBITION / PURPOSE..)]_
(L)_[contrary to a restriction with respect to those goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RESTRICTION..)]_
(M)_[for the purpose of contravening a restriction with respect to those goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RESTRICTION / PURPOSE..)]_
(N)_[without payment having been made of duty payable thereon]_
(O)_[without security having been given for duty payable thereon]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 141(3) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
owner / vehicle operator
of a ship not exceeding 100 tons OR
a railway vehicle / an aircraft / hovercraft liable to forfeiture
under s. 141 Customs and Excise Management Act 1979
by reason of having been used in the
importation / exportation / carriage of goods
contrary to a prohibition / restriction OR
without payment having been made / security given
for any dutiable payable thereon

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: For offences committed on or before 30th December 2020 see offence wording document H10739 (CJS code CE79315).

Summary: A penalty equal to the value of the ship, aircraft or hovercraft or £20,000, whichever is the less.
